oneLine: Dalmia Bharat approves ₹700 crore share buyback.

sources.title: Dalmia Bharat Approves ₹700 Crore Share Buyback at ₹1,850 Per Share, to Repurchase Up to 37.83 Lakh Shares

synopsis: Dalmia Bharat has approved a share buyback of up to ₹700 crore at a maximum price of ₹1,850 per share through the open-market route on the BSE and NSE. The buyback covers up to 37,83,783 fully paid-up equity shares, constituting approximately 2.02% of its existing paid-up equity share capital. The board approved the proposal at its meeting on 23 November 2026, and the buyback is scheduled to open on or before 2 December 2026 for up to 66 working days. Promoters, members of the promoter group, and persons in control of the company are excluded from participating in the buyback.
